name: @hl-bos/sceneflow
description: SceneFlow AI continuation engine. Turns one photograph and a set of structured choices into the next believable moment: cast understanding, character lock, scene lock, spatial map, interaction graph, story planner, continuity inheritance and server-side prompt composition. Pure and deterministic — no network, no model, no secrets — so the safety boundary and the continuity rules are testable without a provider key.
